title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double Shelf with Towel Bar, Solid Brass Wall Mount | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized storage and a towel-hanging solution in one with this wall mount glass shelf. Designed for the Waverly Place collection, it combines 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with solid brass hardware and a built-in towel bar—ideal for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Double glass shelf provides two tiers for toiletries and decor
- Tempered glass (3/8-inch thick) for strength and safety
- Solid brass gallery rail helps keep items secure
- Integrated towel bar adds convenient towel storage
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look

Specs:
- Product type/category: Glass Shelves (glass shelving)
- Collection: Waverly Place (matching Waverly Place)
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 16-inch L x 12-inch H x 5-inch W; 5-inch projection
- Glass thickness: 0.38 inch
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Material: Brass (hardware)
- Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement finishes such as pink, antique pewter, mediterranean blue, lavender, and golden yellow

A refined choice for grooved bathroom hardware-inspired coordination within transitional bath accessories.

_previous.description: Add a flare of style to your décor with this decorative glass shelf. Shelf can be used anywhere in the home for a great space to store your products. Gallery rail will keep your items secure while the integrated towel bar provides a creative space for your towels. Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
